def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=[]
        for c in range(w):
            row.extend([grid[r][c]] * (2 if c < w-1 else 1))
        out.extend([row] * (2 if r < h-1 else 1))
    return [row[:2*w-1] for row in out[:2*h-1]]
